reasons.wiki_unavailable: Monitoring shows HTTP 503 for every wiki user at 09:12, so the wiki is almost certainly unavailable now.
reasons.handling_mode: The user instructions set the objective to classification, which matches giving the incident a type label rather than routing or deploy-gating.
reasons.user_impact: An internal wiki outage for all users is a noticeable disruption to staff work, though with no other service affected it is unlikely to be major.
